snippet.title: Sunrise Story – Weather & Night Showcase | Cozy Pixel Art Inn Game
snippet.description:
Sunny mornings, windy days, cloudy skies, gentle rain and warm lights after dark 🌙

🏡 Wishlist Sunrise Story on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4580050/Sunrise_Story

A quick look at the weather system in Sunrise Story, a cozy pixel art game about running your own little inn. Weather isn't just for looks: it changes how many guests show up at your door.

☀️ Sunny
🍃 Windy
☁️ Cloudy
🌧️ Rainy
🌙 Night

Recorded in-game, with the game's own weather ambience. No music, just the sounds of the inn.

🐦 Follow development on X: https://x.com/sunrisestorydev
